assembly_info.comments: The King penguin is an iconic species of the Southern Ocean and is currently being developed as a model-in-the-wild for understanding evolution. We present a chromosome-level assembly of the King penguin (bAptPat1) which is based on 58.5 Gb of Pacbio Revio data and 126 Gbp of Arima Hi-C data. The initial PacBio assembly generation was performed with Hifiasm and Hi-C based scaffolding with YaHS. The Nextflow pipeline curationpretext was used to create Hi-C contact maps for manual curation. Manual curation was conducted using PretextView and potential microchromosome scaffolds were identified using MicroFinder. The mitochondrial genome was assembled using MitoHiFi. Chromosome-scale scaffolds confirmed by the Hi-C data have been named in order of size.
